facts.value: The International Office for Economics is the central contact point for all students in the department with questions regarding international topics. It particularly advises students on organizing a study abroad and supervises guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

facts.value: International students receive facilitated integration at Goethe University and in Frankfurt through a Frankfurt Buddy. Experienced students from the university provide support in orientation on campus, in studies, and in Frankfurt while also allowing for intercultural and linguistic exchange. The goal is to make the start for international students in Frankfurt life easier and to provide all participants the chance to meet interesting new people from various countries.
